description:
The death land of Cheonmagumyeok (天魔禁域), where the Nine Great Heavenly Demons are imprisoned!

Kwaaang! Lightning strikes from the sky, and the Samramansang Geumsaejin surrounding Cheonmagumyeok is destroyed, causing the Nine Great Heavenly Demons to escape. The terrifying Heavenly Demons and the descendants of the Absolute Five Heavenly Demons are chasing them. The Heavenly Demons, who have reincarnated into unexpected identities, are strangling the world , and the Heavenly Demon Warriors, who were raised solely to fight the Heavenly Demons, appear. A fierce clash between the Nine Great Heavenly Demons and the Heavenly Demon Warriors. The future of the world is born through the clash of the past and the present!!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
